OFF0/ON0/ON1/OFF1. OFF pipeline states/events are null and have no native binding,
state reads or profile installations; common wrappers remain, so neutrality is unproved.

All36 observed ticks have PSSM.update→MainCamera._chase_task→igLoop order.
The original shader setter C-call/normal-return is at PSSM line96, renderFrame at
ShowBase line2158, and original RAM getRamImageAs('RGB') at repo line85. All72
submitted CPU matrix snapshots are unchanged across the setter and equal the
post-PSSM rig matrices. Each observed original RAM method returned the same
non-null object passed through its wrapper. No extra render,step,RAM,GPU or GL call.

There are504observed events,144legacy snapshots,72submitted snapshots and72profile
installations across threeON processes. These observe CPU source locals and dispatch
returns; GPU uniform contents, GPU completion and a shared physical frame remain unproved.
